title: artemisia dracunculoides var. glauca
intro: Artemisia dracunculoides var. glauca, commonly known as Chinese mugwort or ai ye, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties. The health benefits of Artemisia dracunculoides var. glauca include relief from menstrual cramps, improved digestion, and reduced inflammation. The therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoid lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, among others.
